name: natures-insight-memory-card-cost-three-puts-top-three-into-material
notes: Nature's Insight (3bS1Y9OQrF): revealing Dungeon Guide (reserve cost 3) from memory puts it and the top THREE deck cards into the material deck; a marker sits below them. Pre-fix only one deck card moved.

rulesClauses: Reveal a card from your memory and put it into your material deck preserved. X is that card's reserve cost. Then reveal the top X cards of your deck and put them into your material deck preserved.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated customDQHandlers["3bS1Y9OQrF:0:CardActivated-1"] moved the top X deck cards into the material deck with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myMaterial") reading $deck[0]: Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so after the first card "myDeck-0" / $deck[0] was the SAME removed slot and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only ONE deck card ever reached the material deck (the other X-1 stayed on top). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the handler is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone().
